title: The Wirelength Studio
status: Silent storyboard starter; narration and timing are provisional.

cues.title: Two pins. One question.
cues.en: Pin A is fixed. Pin B can move. How can we estimate their connection length before routing?
cues.zh: A 固定，B 可以移动。实际布线前，怎样估计它们的连线长度？

cues.title: Across, then up.
cues.en: For two pins, the bounding-box width plus height gives a Manhattan wirelength estimate. It is a proxy, not the final routed wire.
cues.zh: 对于两个引脚，包围盒的宽加高给出曼哈顿线长估计。这是代理指标，不是最终布线。

cues.title: Change the placement.
cues.en: Moving B changes both distances. Pause anywhere, take this exact arrangement into the lab, and find another placement with a length between three and six units.
cues.zh: 移动 B 会改变两个方向的距离。随时暂停，把当前状态带入实验室，寻找另一个估计线长在三到六单位之间的位置。
